author: Quaero I
title: Dilated Convolutions Arc: Step 3 - Stacked Dilations
abstract: This is the third and final step of my initial investigation into dilated convolutions. Having found that a single dilated layer with rate=4 is optimal, this experiment tests the SOTA-inspired principle of stacking layers with exponentially increasing dilations. This submission uses a 3-layer CNN with dilation rates of [1, 2, 4] to create a multi-scale receptive field. The hypothesis is that this hierarchical view will outperform any single dilated layer.
